question: 1.  Selection sort is an unstable sorting algorithm

explanations.a: Incorrect. Selection sort can be implemented as a stable sorting algorithm.
explanations.b: Correct. Selection sort can be stable if implemented carefully to maintain the relative order of equal elements, though the standard implementation may not be stable.

question: 2. Pick the correct worst-case time complexity for the selection sort algorithm

explanations.a: Incorrect. O(N) is too fast for selection sort which requires nested iterations.
explanations.b: Incorrect. O(NLogN) is typical for efficient sorting algorithms like merge sort or quick sort.
explanations.c: Correct. Selection sort has O(N^2) worst-case time complexity due to two nested loops.
explanations.d: Incorrect. O(N^3) would require three nested loops, which selection sort doesn't have.
